name: Lielow
author: Michael Amundsen & Alek Erickson (2021)
description: Amundsen & Erickson's chess-like played with nothing but checkers: eight stacks a side on the second rank. A stack moves queenwise EXACTLY its own height, jumping anything in the way. Land on an empty square and it grows by one; land on an enemy stack and you take it but reset to height 1; land past the edge and your stack is gone. Your crown moves to whichever stack is your UNIQUE tallest — and stays put when two of yours tie, so your king is not always your biggest piece. Lose the crowned stack, by capture or by walking it off, and you lose the game.
